products.title: Shoei X-14 Full Face Helmet
products.shortDescription: The X-14 is Shoei's track-focused full face, built around a lightweight AIM+ shell and a snug, low-profile fit.
products.description: The X-14 is Shoei's track-focused full face, built around a lightweight AIM+ shell and a snug, low-profile fit. It suits track day riders who want precise feel without paying for a race-only helmet.
products.gearDoctorNote: Wear it in the shop for ten minutes before you buy, because the cheek pads decide whether a helmet feels right or keeps needing adjustment.

images.alt: Shoei X-14 full face helmet in matt black, front three-quarter view
Shoei X-14 full face helmet in matt black, square crop

products.title: AGV Pista GP RR Carbon
products.shortDescription: The Pista GP RR is AGV's top-tier track helmet, with a carbon shell and an aerodynamic profile built for fast laps.
products.description: The Pista GP RR is AGV's top-tier track helmet, with a carbon shell and an aerodynamic profile built for fast laps. It is FIM homologated, which makes it a serious pick for club racing and track days.
products.gearDoctorNote: It is tight and it is loud at speed, so get the cheek pads and fit checked properly before you commit.

images.alt: AGV Pista GP RR carbon race helmet in carbon and red, side view
AGV Pista GP RR carbon race helmet, square crop

products.title: Arai RX-7V Evo
products.shortDescription: The RX-7V Evo is Arai's track-focused full face with a round oval fit that suits narrower heads.
products.description: The RX-7V Evo is Arai's track-focused full face with a round oval fit that suits narrower heads. Its aramid and fibreglass shell is sturdy without being heavy.
products.gearDoctorNote: Arai runs narrow, so if your head is oval, try the RX-7V Evo on before you size up.

images.alt: Arai RX-7V Evo full face helmet in diamond black, front view
Arai RX-7V Evo full face helmet in diamond black, square crop

products.title: HJC RPHA 11 Carbon Full Face
products.shortDescription: The RPHA 11 Carbon is HJC's premium carbon full face with a sleek aerodynamic profile.
products.description: The RPHA 11 Carbon is HJC's premium carbon full face with a sleek aerodynamic profile. It gives sport riders a high-end shell at a mid-range price.
products.gearDoctorNote: Lighter is nice on a long ride, but only if the fit is right; a helmet that shifts at highway speed is a hazard, not a feature.

images.alt: HJC RPHA 11 carbon full face helmet in gloss carbon, front view
HJC RPHA 11 carbon full face helmet, square crop

products.title: LS2 FF805 Thunder Carbon
products.shortDescription: The FF805 Thunder Carbon brings a carbon shell and a quick-release visor to an accessible price.
products.description: The FF805 Thunder Carbon brings a carbon shell and a quick-release visor to an accessible price. It is a practical full face for riders who split their time between city streets and the highway.
products.gearDoctorNote: At this price it is a sensible street helmet, and it is worth checking the inner label for the ECE 22.06 marking before you buy.

images.alt: LS2 FF805 Thunder Carbon full face helmet in carbon and orange, front view
LS2 FF805 Thunder Carbon full face helmet, square crop

products.title: Alpinestars Supertech R10
products.shortDescription: The Supertech R10 is Alpinestars' top full face, with a race-derived shell and a fit system that adapts to a range of head shapes.
products.description: The Supertech R10 is Alpinestars' top full face, with a race-derived shell and a fit system that adapts to a range of head shapes. Its liner is removable and washable, which matters after a hot track day.
products.gearDoctorNote: Take the liner out and wash it after every hot ride, because sweat left in the padding is what makes a helmet smell by the end of the season.

images.alt: Alpinestars Supertech R10 full face helmet in black and red, front view
Alpinestars Supertech R10 full face helmet, square crop

products.title: Alpinestars GP Pro R V3 One-Piece Suit
products.shortDescription: A one-piece leather race suit with a tailored cut that keeps the fabric close without restricting movement.
products.description: A one-piece leather race suit with a tailored cut that keeps the fabric close without restricting movement. CE Level 2 armour sits at the shoulders, elbows, hips and knees.
products.gearDoctorNote: Measure with the leg bent on the bike, not standing, because a suit that feels fine standing can pull across your shoulders when you tuck.

specs.label: Armour
specs.value: CE Level 2 shoulders, elbows, knees and hips

images.alt: Alpinestars GP Pro R V3 one-piece leather race suit in black, white and red
Alpinestars GP Pro R V3 one-piece leather race suit, square crop

products.title: Dainese Misano 3 Perforated One-Piece
products.shortDescription: The Misano 3 is a perforated one-piece for riders who want racing protection with better airflow on hot track days.
products.description: The Misano 3 is a perforated one-piece for riders who want racing protection with better airflow on hot track days. The perforation sits where riders sweat most, and the armour stays in its pockets.
products.gearDoctorNote: Perforation helps, but this is a track suit, not a summer commuter, so do not expect it to feel cool in city traffic.

images.alt: Dainese Misano 3 perforated one-piece race suit in black with red accents
Dainese Misano 3 perforated race suit, square crop

products.title: Revit Quantum 2 Two-Piece Race Suit
products.shortDescription: A two-piece race suit that splits into a jacket and trousers, so you can fit the top and bottom to your own shape.
products.description: A two-piece race suit that splits into a jacket and trousers, so you can fit the top and bottom to your own shape. The relaxed cut suits riders who spend as much time on the road as on the grid.
products.gearDoctorNote: Two-piece suits are worth it if you have a longer torso; make sure the jacket zip overlaps the trousers so air cannot get in at the top of your back at speed.

images.alt: Revit Quantum 2 two-piece race suit jacket and trousers in black and grey
Revit Quantum 2 two-piece race suit, square crop

products.title: Alpinestars GP Plus V4 One-Piece Suit
products.shortDescription: The GP Plus V4 is a one-piece leather suit with a lower price than the GP Pro while keeping the same CE Level 2 armour layout.
products.description: The GP Plus V4 is a one-piece leather suit with a lower price than the GP Pro while keeping the same CE Level 2 armour layout. It is a sensible first leather suit for riders moving from track days into club racing.
products.gearDoctorNote: Check the seams under the arms and at the crotch before you buy, since that is where stitching gets stressed when you tuck.

specs.label: Armour
specs.value: CE Level 2 shoulders, elbows and knees

images.alt: Alpinestars GP Plus V4 one-piece leather race suit in black and yellow
Alpinestars GP Plus V4 one-piece race suit, square crop

products.title: Alpinestars Missile V2 Waterproof Jacket
products.shortDescription: A waterproof textile jacket for sport riders who ride all year round.
products.description: A waterproof textile jacket for sport riders who ride all year round. It has CE Level 2 armour at the shoulders and elbows and a removable thermal liner for cold mornings.
products.gearDoctorNote: Keep the liner in for cold mornings in the hills and take it out once it warms up; that is the whole point of a textile jacket.

images.alt: Alpinestars Missile V2 waterproof textile riding jacket in black
Alpinestars Missile V2 waterproof textile riding jacket, square crop

products.title: Dainese Sport Guard Textile Jacket
products.shortDescription: A textile jacket built around a CE Level 2 armour system, for riders who want protection without the stiffness of leather.
products.description: A textile jacket built around a CE Level 2 armour system, for riders who want protection without the stiffness of leather. Its wide vents make it a practical choice for warm weather riding.
products.gearDoctorNote: Textile is only as good as its armour, so check the back protector sits flat when you zip up and does not float around.

images.alt: Dainese Sport Guard textile riding jacket in black and anthracite
Dainese Sport Guard textile riding jacket, square crop

products.title: Revit Sand 4 H2O Jacket
products.shortDescription: The Sand 4 H2O is a waterproof, ventilated textile jacket with an everyday cut.
products.description: The Sand 4 H2O is a waterproof, ventilated textile jacket with an everyday cut. Its adjustable vents let you dial in airflow, and the pockets fit a phone and a pair of gloves.
products.gearDoctorNote: Shoulder and elbow armour matters, but the back protector is what counts in a fall, so check it sits behind your shoulders.

specs.label: Armour
specs.value: CE Level 2 shoulders, elbows and back

images.alt: Revit Sand 4 H2O waterproof textile jacket in anthracite and orange
Revit Sand 4 H2O waterproof textile jacket, square crop

products.title: Dainese Mugello Leather Jacket
products.shortDescription: A cowhide sport jacket with a tailored fit that sits close to the body for better feel on the bike.
products.description: A cowhide sport jacket with a tailored fit that sits close to the body for better feel on the bike. It comes with CE Level 2 armour and a removable quilted liner for cooler months.
products.gearDoctorNote: Leather softens and stretches a little with wear, so buy the size that fits snug while standing, not the one that feels roomy in the shop.

specs.label: Armour
specs.value: CE Level 2 shoulders, elbows and back

images.alt: Dainese Mugello cowhide leather sport jacket in black
Dainese Mugello cowhide leather sport jacket, square crop

products.title: Alpinestars SP-8 v3 Leather Gloves
products.shortDescription: A full-leather sport glove with a pre-curved fit and a stretch back for comfort on long rides.
products.description: A full-leather sport glove with a pre-curved fit and a stretch back for comfort on long rides. It is CE Level 1 certified, with protection across the knuckles and palm.
products.gearDoctorNote: Buy gloves that fit with your fingers relaxed on the bars, since a glove that is too big makes you grip harder and tires your hands.

images.alt: Alpinestars SP-8 v3 black leather sport gloves, palm view
Alpinestars SP-8 v3 black leather sport gloves, square crop

products.title: Dainese Carbon 4 Short Gloves
products.shortDescription: A short-cuff summer glove with perforated leather and CE Level 2 knuckle protection.
products.description: A short-cuff summer glove with perforated leather and CE Level 2 knuckle protection. It is light enough for hot weather and still covers the hand where most impact protection is needed.
products.gearDoctorNote: Short cuffs are fine in summer, but make sure there is no gap between glove and jacket cuff at speed, because the wind will find it.

images.alt: Dainese Carbon 4 short perforated leather gloves in black
Dainese Carbon 4 short perforated leather gloves, square crop

products.title: Revit Cayenne Pro Gloves
products.shortDescription: A budget-friendly everyday glove with leather palms and a breathable textile back.
products.description: A budget-friendly everyday glove with leather palms and a breathable textile back. It is CE Level 1 rated and suits commuter riders who want solid protection without a race-spec price.
products.gearDoctorNote: For most commuting a Level 1 glove with proper palm leather is enough; spend more when you ride faster, not because the price looks serious.

images.alt: Revit Cayenne Pro anthracite and orange riding gloves, back of hand
Revit Cayenne Pro riding gloves, square crop

products.title: Alpinestars GP Tech v2 Race Gloves
products.shortDescription: A race glove with kangaroo leather palms, pre-curved fingers and hard-shell knuckle protection.
products.description: A race glove with kangaroo leather palms, pre-curved fingers and hard-shell knuckle protection. It is built for riders who want feel on the bars and serious protection in a crash.
products.gearDoctorNote: Hard knuckles are useful, but the glove has to stay on your hand, so pull the strap tight every time.

images.alt: Alpinestars GP Tech v2 black and red race gloves with hard knuckle shells
Alpinestars GP Tech v2 race gloves, square crop

products.title: TCX RT-Race Pro Air
products.shortDescription: A lightweight race boot with a microfibre upper and a race-profile sole for precise braking and gear changes.
products.description: A lightweight race boot with a microfibre upper and a race-profile sole for precise braking and gear changes. The ankle and shin protectors are CE Level 2, and the boot suits riders with narrower feet.
products.gearDoctorNote: Race boots feel stiff in the shop, which is normal, but the heel should not lift when you walk and the toe box should not press.

images.alt: TCX RT-Race Pro Air race boots in black and white, side view
TCX RT-Race Pro Air race boots, square crop

products.title: Alpinestars SMX-6 v2 Vented Boots
products.shortDescription: A vented touring-sport boot with a stable sole and CE Level 1 ankle protection.
products.description: A vented touring-sport boot with a stable sole and CE Level 1 ankle protection. It is a versatile choice for commuting and weekend rides.
products.gearDoctorNote: Vents are great in heat but let water in during wet rides, so keep waterproof covers handy for monsoon season.

images.alt: Alpinestars SMX-6 v2 black vented riding boots, side view
Alpinestars SMX-6 v2 vented riding boots, square crop

products.title: Dainese Axial D1 Air Boots
products.shortDescription: A sport boot with ventilated panels and CE Level 2 protection at the ankle and shin.
products.description: A sport boot with ventilated panels and CE Level 2 protection at the ankle and shin. It gives good feel on the gear lever while keeping the foot cooler on warm rides.
products.gearDoctorNote: Check the shift pad sits correctly under the toe, because a boot that fights the shifter on every gear change turns into a daily irritation.

images.alt: Dainese Axial D1 Air sport boots in black and anthracite, side view
Dainese Axial D1 Air sport boots, square crop

products.shortDescription: A full-race boot with a full-grain leather upper and a sole built for track riding.
products.description: A full-race boot with a full-grain leather upper and a sole built for track riding. The heel and toe sliders are replaceable, which makes it a long-term buy for regular track riders.
products.gearDoctorNote: Keep a spare set of heel and toe sliders in your kit bag, because they wear fast on track and are cheap to swap.

products.title: Alpinestars Nucleon KR-1 Back Protector
products.shortDescription: A back protector with a rigid outer shell and dense inner foam that absorbs impact across the spine.
products.description: A back protector with a rigid outer shell and dense inner foam that absorbs impact across the spine. It can sit inside a compatible jacket or be worn standalone under a textile layer.
products.gearDoctorNote: A back protector does little if it rides up when you sit tall, so check it covers your spine from the base of the neck to the top of your hips.

specs.label: Material
specs.value: Rigid outer shell with dense foam

specs.label: Fit
specs.value: Fits compatible jackets or worn standalone

products.title: Dainese Pro-Armor Chest Protector
products.shortDescription: A chest protector designed to be worn under a jacket or inside a suit, adding impact protection to the upper body.
products.description: A chest protector designed to be worn under a jacket or inside a suit, adding impact protection to the upper body. It attaches with straps so it stays put when you move.
products.gearDoctorNote: A chest protector is one of the cheapest upgrades you can make, and it earns its place the first time the bike lowsides.

images.alt: Dainese Pro-Armor black chest protector, front view
Dainese Pro-Armor chest protector, square crop

products.title: Revit Chest Protector Pro
products.shortDescription: A lightweight chest protector with a low-profile shell and an elastic harness that keeps it close to the body.
products.description: A lightweight chest protector with a low-profile shell and an elastic harness that keeps it close to the body. It suits riders who want protection without bulk under a textile or mesh jacket.
products.gearDoctorNote: Level 1 is a real step up from nothing, but if you ride fast on track, step up to Level 2 armour.

images.alt: Revit Chest Protector Pro black and grey low-profile chest protector
Revit Chest Protector Pro, square crop

products.title: Shoei Pinlock Anti-Fog Insert
products.shortDescription: A dual-pane anti-fog insert that sits behind your visor and keeps the inside of the glass clear in rain and cold air.
products.description: A dual-pane anti-fog insert that sits behind your visor and keeps the inside of the glass clear in rain and cold air. It clips in and out without tools, so you can remove it on a clear day.
products.gearDoctorNote: Fog is what makes riders lift the visor in traffic, so an insert is the cheapest safety upgrade on this page.

Shoei Pinlock anti-fog insert, square crop

products.description: A thin, moisture-wicking balaclava that sits under your helmet and keeps sweat off your face. It works on hot track days as well as cold mornings.
products.gearDoctorNote: A balaclava under the helmet is cheap comfort; wash it after every ride so it stays fresh.
